items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I had a cousin down there, Armand Pierron... And Piku and I were great friends. Because I had a cousin down there, Armand Pierron

ctx.x: No, he was real young when he died, but he was a great violin player. Then, too, there was another trumpet player in the band, another one of the young brothers. His name was Wilson. That's before Uncle Matty knew. But he died young. Unfortunately, the family was, in those days, passing young. So my daddy got an inspiration from those playing. And people in the family, Pierron was a violin player. Exchange their lessons with each other.
Your father, a month ago, mentioned something about this Mr. Augustine. Do you remember?
